## Meet the Core Team

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

library(googlesheets4)
library(dplyr)

# 1. SETUP
gs4_deauth()
sheet_id <- "1reSknnI2NfaYGdCovLiXL7rgnjXCJjLsgrc5rQ39xyw" 
team_data <- read_sheet(sheet_id, sheet = "Staff")

# 2. CSS STYLING
cat('
<style>
  @import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Dancing+Script:wght@600&display=swap");

  /* ANCHOR KILLER */
  .flip-card-front h4 a, .flip-card-back h5 a,
  .flip-card-front h4 .anchorjs-link, .flip-card-back h5 .anchorjs-link,
  .flip-card-front h4::after, .flip-card-back h5::after,
  .flip-card-front h4::before, .flip-card-back h5::before {
    display: none !important;
    visibility: hidden !important;
    content: none !important;
  }

  /* CONTAINER LOGIC */
  .flip-card-front, .flip-card-back {
    display: flex !important;
    flex-direction: column !important;
    align-items: center !important;    
    justify-content: center !important; 
    width: 100% !important;
    height: 100% !important;
    padding: 15px !important;           
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
    text-align: center !important;
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
  }

  .flip-card-front h4 {
    font-family: "Dancing Script", cursive !important;
    font-size: 1.8rem !important;      
    color: #44546a !important;         
    margin: 10px 0 0 0 !important;     
  }

  .flip-card-back {
    overflow-y: auto; 
    background-color: #2c3e50;
    color: white;
  }

  .flip-card-back h5 {
    font-family: system-ui, sans-serif !important;
    font-weight: bold !important;
    font-size: 1.1rem !important;
    margin: 0 0 5px 0 !important;
    color: #abdbe3;
  }

  .back-name {
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    padding-bottom: 5px;
    width: 90%;
  }

  .interest-text {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-style: italic;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    line-height: 1.2;
    padding: 0 5px;
  }

  /* Metrics Styling */
  .metrics-box {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-around;
    width: 100%;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    padding: 8px 0;
    border-radius: 8px;
  }

  .metric-item b {
    display: block;
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    color: #fff;
  }

  .social-links a {
    color: #abdbe3 !important;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    display: inline-block;
    margin: 2px 8px;
  }
</style>
')

# 3. HTML GENERATION
cat('<div class="grid">')

for(i in 1:nrow(team_data)) {
  person <- team_data[i, ]
  
  # Image logic
  photo_path <- paste0("images/team/", person$Photo)
  display_photo <- if (is.na(person$Photo) || !file.exists(photo_path)) {
    paste0("https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=", URLencode(as.character(person$Name)), "&background=random&rounded=true")
  } else { photo_path }

  # Clean up counts (Replaces NA with 0 so the "TRUE" won't appear)
  res_count <- if(is.na(person$"No. of Research Engagement")) "0" else person$"No. of Research Engagement"
  ext_count <- if(is.na(person$"No. of Extension Engagement")) "0" else person$"No. of Extension Engagement"

  cat(paste0(
    '<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-4 g-col-lg-3">',
      '<div class="flip-card">',
        '<div class="flip-card-inner">',
          
          # FRONT
          '<div class="flip-card-front">',
            '<img src="', display_photo, '" class="rounded-circle" style="width:130px; height:130px; object-fit:cover;">',
            '<h4>', person$Name, '</h4>',
          '</div>',
          
          # BACK
          '<div class="flip-card-back">',
            '<h5>', person$Role, '</h5>',
            '<div class="back-name">', person$"Full Name", '</div>',
            
            # Research Interest
            if(!is.na(person$"Research Interest")) paste0('<div class="interest-text">', person$"Research Interest", '</div>'),

            # Fixed Metrics Section
            '<div class="metrics-box">',
              '<div class="metric-item"><b>', res_count, '</b>Research</div>',
              '<div class="metric-item"><b>', ext_count, '</b>Extension</div>',
            '</div>',

            # Links Section
            '<div class="social-links">',
              '<a href="mailto:', person$Email, '">✉️ Email</a>',
              if(!is.na(person$"Google Scholar")) paste0('<a href="', person$"Google Scholar", '" target="_blank">🎓 Scholar</a>'),
              if(!is.na(person$ResearchGate)) paste0('<a href="', person$ResearchGate, '" target="_blank">RG ResearchGate</a>'),
            '</div>',
            
          '</div>',
          
        '</div>',
      '</div>',
    '</div>'
  ))
}

cat('</div>')
```
